Res.Caption: Nudge
Res.FullDescription: The nudge amount applied to workflows with this tag when sorting within the Release Gate.

Res.Caption: Exclusive Tag Sequence
Res.FullDescription: The order in which tag rules are executed for exclusive tags. Tags will only be replaced by tags with a lower sequence in the same tag group.

Res.Caption: Color
Res.FullDescription: The color used to represent this Tag.

Res.Caption: Owner Group
Res.FullDescription: The Group that owns this Tag.

Res.Caption: Apply Color to Ticket Background
Res.FullDescription: Uses the color for the background color of tagged tickets on a Visual Board.

Res.Caption: Apply Color to Ticket Border
Res.FullDescription: Uses the color for the border of tagged tickets on a Visual Board.

Res.Caption: Border Style
Res.FullDescription: Override the border style of tagged items with this style. Leave blank to keep default styles.

Res.Caption: Visualization Priority
Res.FullDescription: The highest priority tag will override other tags for control customization.
